text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*~~... *haaaah*~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So this is... where I currently stand, 
huh...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack...!
choice_data_list: Good work! You really gave it your all.
Good work! You really gave it your all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~... But there were still lots of 
areas to work on. Like how I time my 
spurt, and other things.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Practice really is different from the real 
thing. My legs didn't move as well as I'd 
hoped. ...And I couldn't deliver that 
sharpness like Yaeno-san.

Watching her race, her legs certainly 
seemed to lack that instantaneous burst of 
acceleration.
However, putting it another way—
choice_data_list:
Must be the kind of late burst that 
steadily closes the gap.

Must be the kind of late burst that 
steadily closes the gap.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... In other words, you're saying I 
don't have enough late-kick burst, 
right...?
choice_data_list:
It also gives you the strength to hold out 
that much longer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! I see...! I didn't think of it from 
that angle!

Watching her take notes, I think about the 
next task.

As of right now, her biggest goal is to 
"win the Japanese Derby."

"Then it is crucial to foster the resolve 
to claim victory, and the racing instincts 
to never miss that pivotal, decisive 
moment."

In order to pour everything into the 
Derby, the next battle for the top must 
be—
choice_data_list: Why don't we try entering a GⅠ?
Why not try entering a GⅠ?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? S... wait, woah... a GⅠ...!?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! In that case, I want the 'Asahi Hai 
FS'! The 'Asahi Hai FS' would be great!!

The "Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes" she 
mentioned is a 1,600m turf mile race.

If the goal was the Derby, the Hopeful 
Stakes—being at the same medium distance 
of 2,000m on turf—seemed more suitable, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Because the Asahi Hai FS is the race that 
Maruzen-san won too!!"

"Her passion came through clearly from her 
tone of voice. Facing those sparkling, 
shining eyes, there was only one possible 
answer."
choice_data_list:
Then let's train hard for the Asahi Hai 
FS!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnnngh! Yes, I'll do my very best!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, our next goal has been 
set for the Asahi Hai FS!”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So of all of us, you alone will be the 
challenger to the Junior Class champion, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...The only one? Yaeno-san, are you not 
going to run?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My Make Debut was postponed because 
my legs haven't developed enough.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, this is also a good opportunity. 
I will show you that back then...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —My dream is the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to see with my own eyes the 
moment those eyes of yours bare their 
fangs."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
All to repay my grandfather's kindness. 
For I believe that all things lead to the 
path of self-discipline.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I shall judge your worth in the Asahi Hai 
FS. Now, if you'll excuse me."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, sir...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps I should go watch too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Did you come... to evaluate me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In my case, however, that's only if I can 
get permission from my primary physician.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Best of luck, Chiyono O-san. Hip, hip, 
hooray."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Of course. I'll do... my best.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone left.

"The fuse of destiny has been lit. The 
next step will be the Asahi Hai Futurity 
Stakes."
